headline: Exact Aave Base SUPPLY/HOLD/WITHDRAW lifecycle reached terminal zero, but the card fails because Dashboard APY was unmeasured and the post-teardown Dashboard was unavailable.

A_act: Exactly one SUPPLY executed before eight reasoned HOLD iterations; the action compiled to three required subtransactions.
A1: Three runtime submissions have three unique status-1 receipts and reconcile to wallet nonce 51→54.
A2: Pinned Base block 50073226 has 3,599,999 raw aToken principal and positive collateral; authenticated connector proof is CONFIRMED_OPEN.
A3: Stable SQLite records a HIGH-confidence SUPPLY accounting event with principal_delta_usd 3.600 and interest_delta_usd null.
A4: A separate graceful request was acknowledged, started, executed one WITHDRAW, and completed.
A5: Pinned teardown block 50073511 proves aToken, stable/variable debt, collateral and collateral-use are all zero.
A6: Early/pre-teardown UI showed Supply APY N/A despite a measured ~3.56%; the post-teardown capture is chrome-error ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED and contains no product observation.
A7: Wallet/component PnL differ by only $0.000003193028, inside tolerance; the residual is identified as omitted Base L1 data-fee/native accounting.
A_cap: Funding anchor was $4.01348256, no capital was added mid-run, 3.600001 USDC was swept, and durable pool wallet #1 was released; retained native gas and 360,000 raw allowance are disclosed.

findings: The Dashboard process exited with the runner before the mandatory post-teardown observation, so terminal UI truth is unmeasured.
The required report/deviation freeze occurred after sweep and the observer transcript is not a complete tool-native command record.
Supply APY rendered N/A while the runtime repeatedly measured approximately 3.56%.
Aave accounting used the legacy intent_fallback money-leg guesser rather than a connector-declared PrimitiveMoneyLeg.
Base wallet-native gas cost exceeds persisted gas_used times effective_gas_price by 1,678,873,749 wei, leaving L1 data fees outside ledger gas accounting.
Cleanup left a 360,000-raw USDC allowance to the canonical Aave Pool after token sweep and wallet release.
The result enricher expects redemption_amounts for WITHDRAW while AaveV3ReceiptParser emits withdraw_amounts.
Two position-verifier attempts failed authentication before a distinct session-authenticated read succeeded; all attempts remain preserved.
deviations: Aave lacks a connector-declared PrimitiveMoneyLeg, so ledger construction falls back to intent attributes.
Dashboard does not display the measured Aave supply APY.
TICKET-NEEDED: wire measured Aave supply APY into Dashboard
Managed runner stops the Dashboard before the mandatory post-teardown product observation can be captured.
TICKET-NEEDED: preserve or reproducibly reopen post-teardown Dashboard
Base ledger gas accounting omits the L1 data-fee component observable in wallet native balance deltas.
TICKET-NEEDED: account for OP-stack L1 data fees
Aave WITHDRAW parser capability vocabulary differs from the result enricher expectation.
TICKET-NEEDED: align Aave withdrawal capability naming
Mainnet cleanup leaves non-zero token allowance after the supplied position and wallet token balance reach zero.
TICKET-NEEDED: define revoke-or-quarantine policy for residual approvals
hold: ~9m25s from launch to graceful teardown request; eight reasoned HOLD iterations
money_note: Net component PnL -$0.00580346; wallet/component gap $0.00000319, with Base L1 fee omission disclosed.
